purpose: Teach: 魅せ/お粗末/下品/愕然/幾分/すわっ/ふみ/成り行き

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがお家で素敵な踊りで魅せて下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father's going to treat us to a wonderful dance when he gets home.
lines.style: Warm, conspiratorial delight. Light and teasing. As if sharing a small secret with her son. Open smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「お粗末ですが」って料理を出したよ
lines.en: Mom, I served Dad a meal and said 'nothing fancy' like he taught me.
lines.style: Bright, eager to report. Quick pace. Looking up at her for approval. Small pride underneath the enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、下品な言葉は使わないようにね
lines.en: Sho, we don't use words like that in this house.
lines.style: Gentle but firm correction. Not angry — instructive. A slight pause before the redirect, like she's choosing her words carefully.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんが部屋を綺麗にされてて愕然としたよ
lines.en: Mom, I was so surprised when I saw how clean Dad had left the room.
lines.style: Quiet observation with wry undertone. Slight smile without being mean. The kind of thing a perceptive child notices and doesn't quite know what to do with.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが幾分疲れてらっしゃるみたいね
lines.en: Sho, your father seems a bit tired tonight.
lines.style: Gentle, half to herself. Soft concern. The tone of someone noticing something small but important. Not alarming — just maternal attentiveness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんがソファにすわって新聞を読んでらっしゃるよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad's sitting on the sofa reading the newspaper now.
lines.style: Simple observation. Content tone. Like he's reporting what he sees without judgment. Small comfort in the ordinariness of it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんの足ふみを習いましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's learn your grandfather's foot massage technique together.
lines.style: Warm invitation. Gently purposeful — she's shifting him toward helping. Inclusive tone, like it's something special they'll do as a team.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに任せて成り行きを見守ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I decided to trust Dad and just let things unfold naturally.
lines.style: Quiet sincerity. Mature for his age. Steady pace. A small boy saying something that sounds like it took thinking. Ending on gentle certainty.
